label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: forward PID, dual-radiator RICH: the six sector sensor-box extrusions and the aerogel radiator with a test sensor inside it, as in the ePIC simulation geometry 26.11.0, status development

quantities.name: sectors
quantities.definition: sector sensor-box extrusions (volumes tagged sector) in the expanded IR
quantities.derivation: DRICH_num_sectors = 6, one sensor-box extrusion per sector (eic:C32); the PDR draft states 6 sectors (eic:C34, Tier 2)

independence.result: a design count, not a simulation output; the PDR draft states 6 sectors independently of the geometry file

negative_control.change: five sectors in the ring instead of six

quantities.name: aerogel_cherenkov_angle
quantities.definition: mean polar angle (rad) of the Cherenkov photons a 3000 MeV (kinetic) mu- emits in the aerogel, detected by a sensor inside the aerogel itself, mean per event then over events (gate 2's method)
quantities.derivation: arccos(1/(n beta)) with n = 1.026 at 400 nm (PDR draft, eic:C34, Tier 2; the 2026 dRICH paper calls it the current default, eic:C35) and beta = 0.999421 for a 3000 MeV mu- (muon mass 105.6583755 MeV, core/constants): 0.223068 rad

independence.result: the reference is the Cherenkov relation evaluated with the index the PDR draft states for the selected aerogel, not a Geant4 output; the case's index is the geometry's tabulated value at 400 nm (eic:C33), which equals it. Agreement checks the case's optical material and the photon accounting (option (a), full optical tracking), not the aerogel's dispersion, which the case does not model.

negative_control.change: the earlier aerogel sample's index, 1.019 (eic:C35), instead of 1.026

approximations: the aerogel is a flat disk 4.0 cm thick out to the radiator's outer radius 90.0 - 1.0 - 0.2 = 88.8 cm (eic:C32) with no bore: the bore radius depends on region constants not read; in the geometry it is a cone whose inner radius grows along z

the aerogel index is constant, 1.026 over 2.5-3.5 eV: the geometry's dispersion table (eic:C33) and the PDR's dn/dlambda are not modelled, and the aerogel has no absorption or Rayleigh tables; its composition is SiO2 at 0.110 g/cm3, not the geometry's Air/SiliconDioxide fractions (eic:C33), which matter only for scattering and energy loss

the photon sensor (silicon, 100 x 100 x 1 mm, efficiency 1, no reflection) lies inside the aerogel at its back face, so a detected photon keeps its emission direction: it is a measuring device of the case, not a part of the dRICH; the filter, the C2F6 gas, the mirrors and the SiPM sensor spheres are not modelled (the gas index has no independent reference, so no gas quantity is made)

each sector's sensor-box extrusion (a tube segment 50.0 cm long in z, radii 108-185 cm, 42 degrees wide, centred at (k + 0.5) x 60 degrees, eic:C32) is an air trd with flat faces at apothems 108 and 185 cm and side faces along the 21-degree rays (tan 21 deg = 0.383864, written as a parameter), placed by a ring at the aerogel's z: the overlap check cannot yet judge coaxial phi segments, and these volumes carry the sector count only; the vessel, its walls and the true z positions are not modelled
the muon starts in vacuum 300 mm before the aerogel at x = 500 mm, inside sector 0's azimuth; the vessel length is disputed (geometry 120 cm, PDR 1.27 m) and not used

cherenkov_handling.scintillation: none: aerogel is not a scintillator, so no efficiency map is needed
cherenkov_handling.photons: every Cherenkov photon is tracked by G4OpticalPhysics inside the optical scope (the aerogel and the test sensor); the accounting is separated

status: comparison with cited values: not validated
